title: Billing Office Posting Rule: Contents Months of Home Oxygen Therapy After the Payment Cap
content:
# Contents Months After the Cap — Home Oxygen Therapy

## The rule

> Clause retired in part: "After the cap, classes with a post-cap contents code other than none bill one contents month at the post-cap contents monthly fee times the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule divided by 100, rounded to the cent half up." This clause is no longer in force for a contents month after the payment cap that the coverage paid in full, leaving no patient share because the plan's out-of-pocket maximum was already met. Every other contents month remains under this clause.

The remaining clauses are in force:

1. Contents months follow the same anniversary days as the equipment months.
2. A contents month is billable only when the contents deliveries within the month reach the class's required number of contents deliveries per month. A contents month runs from its first day up to the day before the same day of the next calendar month, and the deliveries counted are the cylinder refill and liquid refill deliveries of the oxygen record with a service date inside that month.
3. Concentrator, home-fill and portable-concentrator classes never bill contents.
4. Contents are billed only after the payment cap: the oxygen record is payment cap reached. The basis is the system record: the status the oxygen record shows.

## Judgement table

| Oxygen record status | Class bills contents | Contents deliveries in the month reach the required number | Contents month barred by these clauses |
|---|---|---|---|
| payment cap reached | yes | yes | no |
| payment cap reached | yes | no | yes |
| payment cap reached | no (concentrator, home-fill or portable-concentrator class) | — | yes |
| any status other than payment cap reached | — | — | yes |

## The contents month (hypothetical)

A hypothetical contents month beginning 12 August runs to 11 September. A cylinder refill delivered on 11 September counts in that month; one delivered on 12 September counts in the next month.
